name: study-sheet
recipe: Interview study sheet. Star headings; every section body framed dashed in an ink that means something (green definition, purple template, red mistakes, blue complexity); template code with a sticky note; condition/action tables; dry-run tables with the answer row highlighted; array walkthroughs with low/mid/high pointers; a cross-list of mistakes; the last page is a revision sheet. No cover page, no hero.
